clause_complexity_theorem.statement: Every auxiliary-free CNF over the five remaining original variables that is logically equivalent to f contains at least 8 clauses.
finite_certificate: Enumerate all 3^5-1 nonempty non-tautological clauses over the five variables.
Retain exactly the clauses satisfied by all 11 models of f; these are the implicates.
Delete non-prime implicates by literal-removal containment; exactly the 13 listed prime implicates remain.

Every clause in any CNF equivalent to f is an implicate and contains a prime implicate. Replacing each clause by a contained prime implicate cannot increase clause count and preserves equivalence to f.
Exhaustively check every subset of at most 7 of the 13 prime implicates: each misses at least one of the 21 nonmodels.
Exhibit an 8-prime cover of all 21 nonmodels, proving the minimum CNF clause count is exactly 8.

maxdef_lower_bound.argument: An auxiliary-free representation uses at most the five remaining variables. With at least 8 clauses its ordinary whole-formula deficiency is at least 8-5=3, and delta* is at least ordinary deficiency.
maxdef_lower_bound.theorem: Every auxiliary-free projection-faithful CNF representation Q of exists x2 G satisfies delta*(Q)>=3.
maxdef_lower_bound.comparison: Parent rank is 2 and both cofactor ranks are 1, so no such representation can satisfy the R44BD target rank <=1; in fact it cannot even return rank <=2.

R44BD_effect.strengthening_over_R44AS: R44AS refuted ordinary DP projection. R44BN lower-bounds every auxiliary-free CNF representation of the same projection function, independently of which equivalent clause set is chosen.
